description:
Lets face it- not everybody needs a folding Trike. The Trident Nomad is our higher spec Non Folding Aluminum Frame Trike. However the frame can be separated into 2 pieces for transport or shipping. The Aluminum frame gives you light weight as well as stiffness. In addition we have simplified the drivetrain using a 1 x 11 system. The Nomad has a 24" Rear Wheel. The Front Wheels are 20". The Nomad has an indirect crossover steering system which gives you great road feel as well as a nice turning circle. Nomad is a narrower trike. at 32" it will fit through a standard doorway. In addition the Nomad uses a slightly wider seat than our other models 17" vs the standard 16" seat.

The Nomad comes in 2 configurations- Non Electric and Electric Power Assist

Nomad features a 1 x 11 Drivetrain with a 48T Front Chainring with a Chainguard and an 11-46 Cassette. This gives you a 25.4-106.3 Gear Inch range. Bar End Shifting, Locking Parking Brake Levers , Avid BB5 Brakes and Schwalbe Tires are all standard equipment. The Nomad also includes a set of 3 Fenders, a Rear Rack , a mirror with a 2 sided accessory mount and a Rear Light.

The Nomad Retails for $1949.00 , it comes approximately 70% Assembled and ships in 1 box.

E Nomad is our Electric/Power Assist version of this Trike. It comes equipped with a 36V 350W Dapu Hub Motor System that includes a Throttle and 6 levels of Power Assist. It comes with a special under-mounted battery rack that is capable of carrying 2 Batteries. The included battery is 16AH. The E Nomad also has 3 Fenders and a Mirror with accessory mount.

An optional additional Rear Rack can be mounted on an E Nomad .

The E Nomad Retails for $3699.00 , it comes approximately 70% Assembled and ships in 1 box.

All Nomads have Indirect Steering. It is only available in Yellow.

Standard Boom length on all Nomads give you an X- Seam range of 35” – 44” Long Booms are available for $60 more which will give you an X Seam Range of 36 1/4 - 50 1/4 “

For shipping quotes to AK, HI and outside the US, please email us
